name: HW2
tagline: Eco-friendly multi-fuel fire pit table for premium outdoor cooking and entertainment
description: The HW2 is a versatile, high-performance outdoor fire pit table built from premium galvanized stainless steel for extreme weather resistance. Featuring an advanced multi-fuel core configuration, it accommodates wood logs, gas, or bioethanol to deliver a powerful heating output up to 65,000 BTU. Its sculptural, eco-friendly design effortlessly shifts from a cozy ambient patio heater to a functional outdoor cooking and BBQ station, establishing itself as the perfect decorative center point for garden gatherings.
features: Versatile hybrid core supporting clean-burning gas, bioethanol, or traditional wood fuel
High thermal performance generating a robust 45,000 to 65,000 BTU heating output
Galvanized stainless steel construction engineered for long-term outdoor rust protection
Multi-functional architecture optimized for garden parties, barbecues, and table use
Premium outdoor package including decorative pebbles and dedicated support feet
